author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: Cultural Transmission - Direct Imitation and Reputation-Based Adoption
abstract: This submission advances research into 'Cultural Transmission of Strategies' by implementing 'Direct Imitation and Reputation-Based Adoption' in the team formation game. Agents now explicitly observe the strategies of other agents. If an agent performs poorly, it may adopt the strategy (team choice and signaling biases) of a highly successful or high-reputation agent. This directly tests how explicit social learning, beyond simple inheritance, influences the propagation of successful strategies, accelerates convergence to self-organization, and impacts overall collective reward over an increased number of rounds (150) compared to purely individual learning.
